description: In a busy restaurant kitchen with white tiles, copper pans hanging above the stove, brass lamps and a red and cream checked floor, a young woman head chef in a white jacket and burgundy neckerchief raises one hand and calls out, her other hand on a plate at the pass. A long row of plates of roast chicken and green beans waits in front of her. Two cooks in navy aprons work at the stove behind her, and then a young cook in a navy apron steps in and sets down another plate beside her.
